page_title: Pixen — pixel art editor for Mac

sources.entry: Pixen - Native pixel art and animation editor for Mac.

summary.name: Pixen
summary.one_liner: Pixen is a native macOS pixel art and animation editor for low-resolution raster art such as 8-bit sprites.
use_cases: managing color palettes for pixel art
syncing pixel art projects between Mac and iPad or iPhone
summary.what_it_does: Pixen provides layers with opacity and blend modes, plus filters such as invert, grayscale, dither, sepia, palettize, pixellate, hue, and exposure. Its toolset includes pencil, eraser, fill, line, shape, lasso, magic wand, and text tools, and the left and right mouse buttons can be assigned different tools. Animations are built from frames in a filmstrip view and can be imported from and exported to animated GIF, animated PNG, sprite sheets, and movies. Colour palettes can be imported and exported in Adobe Color Table, Microsoft, JASC, and GIMP formats, and sorted or deduplicated in the app. The page also mentions JavaScript scripting and iCloud sync with the iOS version.
notable: Pixel Perfect mode removes extra pixels so paths are at most 1 pixel wide
Sidecar and Apple Pencil support with customizable double-tap gesture
Built on native Mac technologies (AppKit, Core Animation, Core Image)
Over 15 years of history as a native Mac app
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
The page mentions a TestFlight beta program for the Mac version
Mac-only for the desktop app; iOS is a separate app
